_doc: DEWY receipt for 2026-08-28 — naming ARCS's two-surface architecture (Receipt + Induction). See ADR-070, witness stub _STATE/witness/2026-08-28.jsonl, and Tao proverb tao-254.

receipts.sharp_question: What is the surface that serves pre-verbal, exploratory, can't-yet-name-it work, and how does it relate to the receipt?

dewy_vector.D: Canonize ADR-070: ARCS is TWO surfaces. Receipt = deductive/backward, records earned coherence. Induction = abductive/forward, recognizes the job-pattern (often before the human does), keeps the human honest vs ground truth, and forges the purpose-built instrument that fits. The meandering is the generative medium, not waste.
dewy_vector.E: The Folksonomist (induction engine, scripts/arcs_core.py); NOTOMATION (constitutional floor); the Receipt/DEWY/witness models (the other surface); every purpose-built instrument minted this session as induction-surface evidence.
dewy_vector.W: YEARS / constitutional — a naming of existing architecture, governs how future surfaces are classified (attest-the-past vs forge-for-a-pre-verbal-future).
dewy_vector.Y: GREEN — named live by the user as 'the whole point of ARCS', corroborated by ~7 in-session instrument-mints and prior canon (ADR-053 Tao, Folksonomist, WORLD.md Myst/Guide register). Falsifier: if all valued outputs reduce to records of already-articulated decisions, the induction surface is decoration.
